Japanese timing table lists six firing frames in addition to the charge. Local v1110 charge frames remain authoritative; this avoids treating movement PostDelayFrame as a serial charge delay.
200 damage at4-frame intervals is3000 damage/s; this is a Grizzco exception, not an ordinary charger minimum-charge mode.
Both English and Japanese tables identify17F between divided charged shots. Raw PostDelayFrame15 is not silently relabelled17.

Weapon page says8F after last L3 shot; H3 page20F. Published sustained DPS tables give inconsistent total periods due to trigger animation conventions. Model retains raw gaps8/20 and states this theoretical lower-bound timing assumption instead of reverse-calibrating them.

warnings: Leanny v1110 raw files have the same sparse fields as local files; re-downloading them does not recover omitted class defaults.
External live stat pages contain other game versions. They are crosschecks or default evidence, never replacements for local v1110 values.
ThroughFullCharge means enemy penetration; FriendThroughFrameForPlayer is not evidence for enemy penetration.
Raw PostDelayFrame, ink recovery lock, next-shot interval and time to enter swim form are different quantities.
Stringer direct hits and the explosion of that same arrow are alternative outcomes, not automatically additive damage to one target.
